name: Astrid Berg
bio:
Astrid Berg's journey in motorsport began unexpectedly. Initially a logistics manager for a construction firm, she was drawn to the precision and teamwork she witnessed during a local rally event. She volunteered, quickly rising through the ranks due to her exceptional organizational skills and sharp understanding of race strategy. Recognizing her talent, Racing Start Academy headhunted her to guide their junior drivers.

Astrid is known for her pragmatic, no-nonsense approach. She excels at identifying weaknesses in both drivers and the team, pushing for improvements with data-driven decisions. Her strength lies in her ability to see the big picture, ensuring every element, from pit stops to driver training, contributes to overall performance. She is respected for her direct communication and commitment to fostering a competitive yet supportive environment.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, often pulled back into a practical ponytail.
physical.description: A tall, athletic woman with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on a pre-race team huddle for a quick strategy review, regardless of the weather.
